name: 比亚尔尼·斯诺里松
src: 纷争纪/补卷/补卷_38_遗物的原主.md:85
gear: 英雄（最后那一槊跨进传奇）｜贫（霜渡摆渡人家）｜朴素（摆渡人，只拿梁上那杆槊）｜4档｜北段冰上打了三十年到英雄，英雄不看家境定四档；号角的年月墙上的附魔甲传下来补着穿，他那一副是自己的旧半身甲，素、补过，回家接船以后外头照旧是羊毛斗篷和摆渡绳，光在槊刃那一片神骸上。
who: Bjarni Snorrason, a human ferryman of Frost Crossing in the far north, eldest son of the ferry family, fifty-one and looking a hard-weathered fifty: tall, about 188 cm, with big hands and long arms. Fiery red hair and a red beard braided into one thick braid, a few grey threads in the red. Ice-blue eyes. A chunk missing from the rim of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us), bitten off by an ice-maned wolf on the wall. Fine lines at the eyes and cheeks reddened by the cold. A coil of ferry rope wound round his waist. A quiet, terse northern air; he counts his steps aloud when he carries someone over the ice, so they will not be afraid.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man's face of about fifty, NOT young: ice-blue eyes with deep lines at the corners, heavy red brows, cheeks and nose reddened by the cold, a firm closed mouth inside the braided red beard, a few grey threads in the red.
build: 188 cm, tall and long-limbed: broad bony shoulders, big hands, a lean, hard frame.
palette: fiery red, ice blue, undyed grey-white sheep wool, tarred rope brown, cold water-clear pale blue
casual: His winter ferry clothes: a heavy undyed sheep-wool cloak with a hood, sewn by the stone-house families of the ice plains, over a thick grey wool tunic and a sheepskin vest, dark wool trousers, fur-lined boots; a coil of tarred ferry rope wound round and round his waist. He holds a long ferry pole upright in one hand, a calm, watchful look.
private: At home in the ferry house in the evening: a plain long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, dark trousers, thick wool socks, the red beard braid lying on his chest. He holds a single small cup of ale, his one cup, a quiet look.
battle: Holding Frost Crossing: his north-wall harness from thirty winters on the ice, a fitted half-plate of dark enchanted steel made for him, plain and unornamented, mended at the left shoulder, its rune lines glowing frost-white and a fresh crystal lit in the breastplate socket, rune-etched steel vambraces, the hooded sheep-wool cloak thrown back, the ferry rope still wound round his waist. He grips the heavy lance in both hands, NOT a curved sword: a dark later-fitted shaft and a long blade of cold, water-clear pale bone glowing with a faint holy blue-white light, a ring of notches of different depths cut round the joint, frost streaming off the blade. Feet planted, a grim, still look.
formal: On the first day of snow, when he cleans the blue stone at the landing: a clean long sheep-wool cloak pinned with a plain iron clasp over a dark-blue wool tunic, the ferry rope coiled neatly at his waist, the beard braid freshly tied, a folded wool cloth in one hand. He stands straight, a solemn, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the ice-blue eyes looking at the viewer steadily, a brief closed-mouth smile. Cold white light off river ice from below, a pale grey sky. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and the frosted edge of a pale lance blade. He wears the hooded sheep-wool cloak.

name: 茜洛恩
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:2342
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 208）｜不看（传奇）｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇定顶档；深潮那一边不造炉、不烧魔晶，顶档落在海鳞甲、黑铁边、鳍形肩甲和珊瑚红的纹上，两柄同长的黑铁叉各引一道反向的水。
who: Siloen, a deep-tide serpent demon woman with four arms, a legend of the Salt Sea Gate called Twin Forks Beneath the Tide, about six hundred and forty when her name was fixed and still looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 181 cm, tall and long-waisted. Blue-grey skin. Short blue-black hair slicked straight back. Bright coral-red eyes. A dorsal fin running from the nape down the spine to the small of the back, its tips purple. Four arms of nearly equal thickness, an upper pair and a lower pair, both pairs with fork-grip calluses on the palms; fine dark scales on her legs. A competitive, proud, teasing air; when people stare she says her own name very clearly.
face: FACE, as in the references: a striking woman's face of about twenty-eight: bright coral-red eyes, sharp brows, a straight nose, a confident closed-mouth smile; blue-grey skin with cool teal shadows; the blue-black hair slicked back.
build: 181 cm, tall and long-waisted: strong shoulders carrying four arms, a D-cup, a long narrow waist and rounded hips, long strong legs covered in fine dark scales.
palette: blue grey, blue black, coral red, deep purple, black iron, sea-foam white
casual: Her gate gear: a close-fitting armour of small dark sea-scales from the neck to the hips, cut with two extra sleeve openings for her lower arms and an open slot down the back for the dorsal fin, a short belted overskirt of layered dark sea-sinew cloth over fitted scaled leggings, soft dark boots. Two black-iron war forks of exactly equal length, their tines carved with spiral grooves, one turning with the flow and one against it: the upper right hand rests one fork on her shoulder, the lower left hand holds the other point-down. A proud, teasing look.
private: Off duty on the gate pier: a loose dark-blue sea-silk tunic with four short wide sleeves and an opening for the fin, wide-legged dark trousers, barefoot. She holds a bowl in her two lower hands and eats from it with the upper ones, a relaxed grin.
battle: Turning ships over in the gate channel: an over-designed deep-tide war harness of dark sea-scale plate edged in black iron, large sculpted fin-shaped pauldrons over both upper shoulders and smaller matching ones over the lower, purple-tinted plates along the spine framing her dorsal fin, coral-red runes glowing along every edge, long dark-purple sash ribbons streaming, scaled greaves. All four hands grip the two black-iron war forks, one raised high by the upper pair and one thrust forward by the lower pair, each trailing a spiralling ribbon of water, one turning left and one turning right, the tines glowing coral red. Feet planted wide, a fierce, delighted look.
formal: Returning to the old beach to keep her word: a long fitted gown of deep-blue sea-silk to the ankles with four close-fitting long sleeves and a high collar, a cape of shimmering dark scales open at the back for the fin, a single coral pin in the slicked hair, the forks left behind. She stands straight with the upper hands clasped and the lower hands at her sides, a calm, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait at a slight angle, the coral-red eyes looking at the viewer with a challenging, amused smile, one hand lifting a black-iron war fork upright beside her face. Cold grey-green sea light from above, glints of water on her blue-grey skin. Foreground blur: flying spray and a purple fin tip. She wears the close-fitting dark scale armour.

name: 德鲁姆
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:2381
gear: 传奇（撼世，10992年到天灾 LVL 228）｜中（骨匠会）｜朴素（接骨的骨匠，先接活人）｜5档｜传奇顶档、不看家境；他是接骨的骨匠，不爱披挂，顶档落在骨匠会刻接骨纹的白骨甲片上，样子素，光在指骨的白绿髓焰和凿尖上。
who: Drum, a white-bone demon man, head of the bone-smiths on the northern edge of the death frontier, a legend called the Re-Joiner, about five hundred and eighty when his name was fixed and still looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 189 cm, long-armed, the shoulders a little narrow, the back very straight. Short misty-violet hair. Bright gold-green eyes. On his left cheek (on the viewer's right when he faces us) a smooth oval of polished white bone shows through like porcelain, with no wound around it. His wrist bones grow outside the skin as smooth white bone cuffs. Long fingers that can spread unusually wide. A gentle, attentive, earnest air; he asks everyone he mends to say their number back to him.
face: FACE, as in the references: a fine-featured young man's face of about twenty-eight: bright gold-green eyes, thin straight brows, a straight nose, a gentle closed mouth; pale skin with soft cool shadows; on the left cheek a smooth oval of polished white bone set flush in the skin like porcelain, clean, NOT a wound.
build: 189 cm, tall and long-armed: slightly narrow shoulders, a very straight back, a lean frame, long hands.
palette: bone white and ash grey, misty violet, gold green, pale green marrow-fire
casual: His bone-smith's clothes: a long grey-white leather apron over a dark grey long-sleeved tunic with the cuffs bound tight round his bone wrists, the collar a little rumpled and not quite clean, dark trousers, soft boots; a roll of spotless white cloth wrapped round his chisels hangs at his belt. He holds the short-handled bone chisel in one hand, its handle worn smooth with old grip marks, a calm, attentive look.
private: Resting after a long day of mending: the apron off, a loose long-sleeved grey linen shirt with the cuffs open, dark trousers, barefoot. He wrings out a freshly washed white chisel cloth in his hands, a tired, gentle smile.
battle: Re-joining the broken: over the grey-white apron a bone-smith's harness of carved pale bone plates laced with grey cord, plain and close-fitting, each plate etched with fine joining lines that glow pale white-green, bone vambraces that flow into his own bare wrist bones, a short ash-grey hooded mantle. In his right hand the short bone chisel, its tip lit with white-green marrow fire; his left hand spread wide with the fingers fanned out, pale white-green flame rising from every finger bone and fine threads of light reaching out from them like the lines of a skeleton. A focused, calm look.
formal: Before the bone-smith guild at a rite: a long ash-grey robe to the ankles buttoned down the front with small white bone buttons, fitted sleeves bound at the wrist, a chain of white bone beads across the chest, for once a fresh clean collar, the chisel roll held in both hands. He stands straight, a quiet, earnest look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the gold-green eyes looking at the viewer kindly, one long-fingered hand raised near his face with a small pale-green flame on each fingertip lighting the bone patch on his cheek. Dim grey frontier light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting white bone dust like snow. He wears the grey-white leather apron.

name: 茱涅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:2303
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 203）｜中（银帆港引船人）｜不靠装备（游着领船）｜5档｜撼世传奇顶档、不看家境，可她靠游泳和鳃光领船，不穿甲，只一副轻的海鳞护胸、护肩和护臂，光在鳃纹和那一盏小灯上。
who: Junie, a sea-folk woman of Silversail Harbour, a ship-guide and a legend called One Woman's Sea Lane, about seventy-eight when her name was fixed and still looking about thirty: about 167 cm, narrow-shouldered and long-legged. Long lake-blue hair tied back at the nape. Pale gold eyes. Thin transparent fins along the rims of her ears that twitch when she talks. Two gill lines on each side of her neck that glow gold-white when lit, lighting her jaw. Fine small scales on her forearms. A small cold-light lamp at her waist. A gentle, caring air; she walks people to the door and still asks whether they got home.
build: 167 cm, slender: narrow shoulders, a C-cup, a slim waist, long legs.
palette: lake blue, pale gold, sea-foam white, gold-white glow, harbour grey
casual: Her harbour clothes for swimming: a short white sea-silk overjacket with long fitted sleeves, belted, over a close-fitting long-sleeved white swimming tunic and fitted pale grey leggings, barefoot; the small cold-light lamp hangs at her belt, two gold lines etched on its glass. The ear fins and the gill lines on her neck show. She stands at ease, one hand resting on the little lamp, a soft smile.
private: At home by the harbour: a loose long-sleeved pale blue knitted dress to the ankles, the blue hair loose over one shoulder, soft shoes. She holds a cup of warm tea in both hands, a quiet, wistful look.
battle: Guiding ships through the fog: the white swimming tunic and leggings under a light, sleek harness of pale sea-scale plates over the chest and shoulders, its gold-white rune lines curving like water currents, fitted scaled bracers, the overjacket shed. She carries no weapon: the little lamp is held up in her right hand glowing gold-white, the gill lines on her neck blazing, a ribbon of gold-white water-light streaming from her open left palm and circling her body. A steady, calm look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: poised and light on her feet, the right hand raising a small glowing lamp, the left arm extended with the palm open, a calm, focused expression; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the harbour wall the day the forty-one ships came in: a long white sea-silk gown to the ankles with fitted long sleeves and a high collar, a short white cape fastened with a gold shell clasp, the blue hair tied with a gold-white ribbon, the little lamp on a fine chain at the waist. She stands with the hands folded, a warm, quiet smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait rising out of dark water, the face turned toward the viewer, the pale gold eyes soft, a gentle closed-mouth smile, the gill lines on her neck glowing gold-white and lighting her jaw. Cold blue fog light all around, a warm gold glow from below. Foreground blur: drifting fog and water droplets. Wet blue hair clings to her shoulders.

name: 莉蔻
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:2459
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 205）｜中（夜翼信使）｜不靠装备（信使，靠翼）｜5档｜撼世传奇顶档、不看家境，可她是信使，不拿兵器、不披重甲，只一副留出翼根的骨片轻甲，光在翼缘的青光上。
who: Liko, a night-wing demon woman, a courier between the outposts of the death frontier, a legend called the Wing That Carries Letters, about two hundred and eighty-five when her name was fixed and still looking twenty-two or twenty-three: about 164 cm, light-framed with a strong back. Short pale peach-gold hair. Blue-green eyes. Two small horns at the temples curving back into the hair. A pair of black wings edged with a band of fine pale violet lines, rising half a head above her shoulders when folded. Small pointed canines that show when she smiles. A letter bag strapped across her chest. A curious, earnest, head-tilting air; she cannot read, so she remembers every face she delivers to.
build: 164 cm, light and slim: a strong back and shoulders for flying, a C-cup, a narrow waist, slim legs.
palette: black wing and pale violet, pale peach gold, blue green, worn dark leather, sky-teal glow
casual: Her courier's clothes: a short dark leather jacket with long sleeves, split at the back and edged with soft leather to let the wings through, the buckles set clear of the wing roots, dark fitted trousers and soft flying boots; a flat letter bag lined with thin wing-leather strapped across her chest, a little door pattern she carved herself on the back of its buckle. She tilts her head at the viewer, the wings folded, a curious look.
private: Resting between flights: a loose long-sleeved grey wool tunic split at the back for the wings, soft trousers, barefoot, the letter bag still on. She holds a letter upside down in both hands, frowning at the writing, the wings drooping.
battle: Cutting a corridor through the wild winds: a light flight harness of dark leather and thin carved bone plates over the short jacket, a fitted bone-plated vest across the chest and back that leaves the wing roots free, the letter bag strapped tight beneath it, bone-ringed bracers, the wing edges blazing with sky-teal light along their violet lines. She carries no weapon: the black wings spread wide, one arm stretched forward to point the way, the other hand clamped on the letter bag strap, a fierce, focused look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: the black wings spread wide behind her, leaning forward as if about to dive, one arm stretched forward pointing the way, the other hand gripping the letter bag strap at her chest, a fierce, focused expression; she carries no weapon.
formal: Delivering a letter to an important house: the leather jacket brushed, a short dark violet cape split for the wings and fastened at the throat with a small bone clasp, a clean long-sleeved grey shirt, the letter bag polished and its buckle shining, the short hair smoothed. She stands with the heels together and the wings folded neatly, holding a sealed letter out in both hands, a serious, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait with the head tilted, the blue-green eyes looking at the viewer with a curious smile that shows two small pointed canines, the black wings rising behind her shoulders. Cold windy grey sky light from above, a sky-teal glow along the wing edge. Foreground blur: a drifting black feather and wind-blown dust. She wears the short leather jacket with the letter bag across her chest.

name: 奥兹嘉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:2420
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 209）｜不看（传奇）｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇定顶档；炎角那一边不造炉，顶档落在赤黑甲、黑曜边、熔缝和角上的白金火上，熔过亮边的膝甲照页上留着，角火顺枪脊烧到刃上。
who: Ozga, a fire-horned demon woman of a war-band beyond the middle wall, a legend called Seven Charges, about three hundred and fifty-five when her name was fixed and still looking twenty-five or twenty-six: tall, about 184 cm, long-legged, with thick strong shoulders and a solid waist. Reddish-brown demon skin. Long red-gold hair woven into a tight braid that lies flat down her back. Deep violet eyes slightly upturned at the outer corners. A pair of black horns curving back, their tips burning white-gold when lit; a ring of black obsidian round the root of the right horn, and only half a ring left on the left one (on the viewer's right when she faces us). A bold, reckless, head-tilting air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a striking woman's face of about twenty-five: deep violet eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, bold brows, a straight nose, a wide confident mouth; reddish-brown skin with warm red shadows.
build: 184 cm, tall and powerful: thick strong shoulders, an E-cup, a solid firm waist and rounded hips, long strong legs.
palette: red gold, deep violet, reddish brown, black obsidian, molten white-gold
casual: Her war-band clothes: a red-bronze breastplate over a dark close-fitting long-sleeved wool tunic, a broad belt, dark leather breeches and tall boots with knee guards whose edges have melted bright; the red-black long spear rests on her shoulder, three old notches in its blade. She stands with her head tilted, the end of her braid held in her teeth while she ties it, a cocky look.
private: In her brother's tent: a loose long-sleeved dark-red wool tunic to mid-thigh over dark trousers, barefoot, the braid let loose. She holds a cup in one hand and gestures wide with the other, laughing.
battle: Charging for the seventh time: an over-designed fire-horn war harness of red-black plate edged with black obsidian, sculpted flame-shaped pauldrons, a tall obsidian collar, the plates cracked with glowing molten seams, knee guards running with molten bright edges, long red-gold sash ribbons streaming behind; the horn tips burning tall with white-gold fire, the half-broken obsidian ring on the left horn glowing. She levels the red-black spear in both hands in a charging lunge, horn fire running down its shaft to the notched blade and trailing a ribbon of molten red light from the point. A fierce grin.
formal: At the war-band fire after a raid: a long dark-red wool robe to the ankles buttoned down the front with fitted long sleeves, a broad belt of black obsidian plates, a short cloak of red-gold dyed hide over one shoulder, the braid tied with a red cord, the horn rings polished. She stands with one hand on her belt, a bright, proud look.
art: A portrait at a tilt, the deep violet eyes looking at the viewer from under the brows, a bold grin, the end of the braid held in her teeth as she ties it up. Hot red-orange firelight from below and one side, the horn tips burning white-gold. Foreground blur: rising embers. She wears the red-bronze breastplate.

name: 霍尔妲·布伦海姆
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:2264
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 204）｜世家（布伦海姆家）｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇顶档；照页上白衬衣外深蓝板甲、削去一边肩甲好贴旗杆，顶档是量身打的贾曼尼深蓝附魔板甲嵌银、旗风纹发蓝白光，她不拿兵器，拿那面无字旗。
who: Holda Brunnheim, a human of the Jarmani Brunnheim family, the legendary warden of the Ninth Banner Keep called the Nameless Banner, thirty-four when her name was fixed and looking thirty-four ever since: about 178 cm, broad-shouldered and straight-backed, with a firm, solid waist and thick calluses on both palms from gripping a banner pole. Short apricot-gold hair, one lock always falling over her forehead. Violet-blue eyes. Three faint freckles on the right side of the bridge of her nose (on the viewer's left when she faces us). Her left shoulder sits higher than her right from carrying the banner. A stubborn, steady, protective air.
build: 178 cm, broad-shouldered and straight-backed: strong back and arms, a D-cup, a firm solid waist and rounded hips, strong legs.
palette: deep navy blue, apricot gold, violet blue, white linen, patched banner blues, silver
casual: Her keep warden's gear: deep-blue plate armour over a white linen shirt whose collar and cuffs show, the pauldron cut away on the left side so the banner pole can rest against the shoulder (on the viewer's right when she faces us), a full pauldron on the right, plated gauntlets, dark breeches and armoured boots. The banner pole rests on her left shoulder, its old blue banner with no letters on it hanging down, patched with blue cloths of different shades. A steady, relaxed look.
private: Off duty in the keep: a white linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a dark-blue wool waistcoat, dark trousers, soft boots. She mends the frayed edge of a blue banner with a needle and thread held in her hands, a calm look.
battle: Holding the gate for nine days: an over-designed deep-blue Jarmani war plate inlaid with silver, the breastplate and the large layered right pauldron chased with banner-and-wind patterns whose engraved lines glow blue-white, the left pauldron cut away to a smooth shoulder plate for the pole, a tall silver-edged collar, a long dark-blue cloak lined in white, the white shirt cuffs showing at the wrists. Both hands grip the banner pole braced on her left shoulder, the patched, letterless blue banner streaming out sideways and blue-white wind-light pouring from its cloth in a curved wall around her. Feet planted, a stubborn, steady look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and steady, the feet planted wide, both hands gripping a banner pole braced on the left shoulder with the banner streaming out to one side, a stubborn, steady expression; she carries no other weapon.
formal: At the keep on gate-day: the deep-blue plate polished under a long white wool surcoat, a small silver family crest of a banner over a well pinned at the collar, a dark-blue cloak, the apricot hair brushed back with the one lock falling free; the old banner folded and held across her forearms. She stands straight, a warm, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly with the left shoulder raised, the violet-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a small grin that crowds the freckles beside her nose. Bright blue-white daylight from one side, wind blowing the loose lock across her brow. Foreground blur: the edge of a patched blue banner rippling. She wears the deep-blue plate with the white shirt collar.
